# Ease — Strict Rules, Annotated Reference & Execution Semantics

Ease is a bracket-free, immutable-by-default language. Every construct has one canonical syntax and zero silent fallbacks.

## 1. Critical Compiler & Semantics Laws

| Rule | Forbidden | Required Form |
|---|---|---|
| **Max 1 `->` per line** | `-> loop xs -> expr`, `-> swarm loop xs -> expr` | `res = swarm loop xs -> expr` then newline `-> res` |
| **Record vs List `with`** | `a with .field = v` or `xs with 2 = v` | Record: `a with field = v` (NO dot) \| List: `xs with .2 = v` (dot for `1..N` index only!) |
| **Single Rec vs List** | `list as Rec with a = 1 end` for 1 rec; bare `with` on list | 1 rec: `Rec with a = 1, b = 2` \| list: `list as Rec with ... end` \| `update xs [where c] with f = v` |
| **Void Loops** | `loop items -> put ch it`, `-> say x`, `to f x -> y` | Multi-line `loop items` + newline `put ch it` + `end`; `def`/`to`/`test` close with `end` |
| **Exhaustive Return** | Value `to` ending with `check ... end` and no final `->` | Always end `to` with an unconditional `-> fallback` (or bind `res` before `check` and `-> res`) |
| **No `else check`** | `else check cond` on one line; multi-line `check cond ->` | Sequential `check` blocks, or `else` + newline + indented `check` + `end` |
| **Block Scoping** | Reading vars first assigned inside `check`/`loop` after `end` | Initialize `acc = 0` BEFORE `check`/`loop`; params & globals are read-only inside `to` |
| **No Booleans** | `bool`, `true`, `false`, `if`, `==`, `!=` | `is`, `is not`, `contains`, `<`, `<=`, `>`, `>=`, `and`, `or`, `not` only in `check`/`where`/`test`; unions for states |
| **`where` Re-Indexing** | Assuming `it.index` keeps original positions after `where` | `where` creates a NEW `1..M` list FIRST! In `loop ((list 10, 30, 5) where it > 10) -> it.index`, `it.index` is **`1`**, NOT `2`! |
| **Short-Circuit Predicates** | Storing `any`/`none` in a var or evaluating all items eagerly | `any`/`none` live ONLY in conditions (`check`/`test`), never in vars (`x = any ...` is `TypeError`); `any` stops on the **first match** (later items never run!). |
| **Union `sort by` Order** | Sorting closed literal unions alphabetically | Closed literal unions (`def P = "urgent" \| "routine" \| "low"`) ALWAYS sort in **declaration order** (`"urgent"` first!) |

Reserved names (FORBIDDEN as vars/params/`to` names): `ask`, `count`, `type`, `fields`, `abs`, `floor`, `round`, `min`, `max`, `range`, `append`, `slice`, `split`, `join`, `trim`, `upper`, `lower`, `replace`, `contains`, `sum`, `avg`, `sort`, `load`, `save`, `put`, `close`, `of`, `it` (`def` fields cannot be `index`). Unused locals or discarded non-void returns are static TypeErrors.

## 2. VERIFIED EXAMPLE

```ease
import random

# Closed literal union: declaration order ("urgent" < "routine" < "low"), NOT alphabetical
def Priority = "urgent" | "routine" | "low"

def Ticket
    id   = 0
    name = "Guest"
    prio = Priority    # Reference union name, NOT "low"
end

def Summary
    id    = 0
    label = ""
end

def base_score = 10    # Order-independent immutable constant

to classify_ticket t as text
    check t.prio is "urgent"
        -> "fast"
    end
    check t.prio is "routine"
        -> "normal"
    end
    -> "backlog"       # Mandatory unconditional fallback
end

to summarize_urgent items as list of Summary
    kept = items where it.prio is "urgent"
    ordered = sort kept by it.prio, it.id
    res = loop ordered -> Summary with id = it.id, label = "{it.index}:{it.name}"
    -> res
end

to relay_worker src dst
    take src
        check it < 0
            close dst
            -> return
        end
        check it is 0
            -> stop
        end
        put dst (it * 2)
    end
    close dst
end

to run_relay nums as list of number
    src = inbox as number
    dst = inbox as number
    spawn relay_worker src dst
    loop nums
        put src it
    end
    close src
    out = list as number
    take dst
        out = append out it
    end
    -> out
end

to parse_line line as text
    match line
        "{lvl as Priority} [{code as number}] {msg}" -> "{lvl}:{code}:{msg}"
        else -> "invalid"
    end
end

to batch_scores nums as list of number
    scaled = swarm loop nums -> it * base_score
    -> scaled
end

slots = (range 1 4) * 0
bumped = slots with .2 = slots.2 + 1       # List index uses .2
tickets = list as Ticket with
    id = 1, name = "Bram", prio = "low"
    id = 2, name = "Aria", prio = "urgent"
end
escalated = update tickets where it.name is "Bram" with prio = "routine"
ordered = sort escalated by it.prio, it.id
renamed = ordered.1 with name = "Aria!"     # Record field has NO dot
rolled = random:roll 1 1

raw_json = '{"id": 9, "label": "ok"}'
m = raw_json as json
parsed_summary = m as Summary

test "sandwich_reference"
    bumped is list 0, 1, 0, 0
    ordered.1.name is "Aria"
    renamed.name is "Aria!"
    ordered.2.prio is "routine"
    (classify_ticket ordered.1) is "fast"
    (classify_ticket ordered.2) is "normal"
    summaries = summarize_urgent ordered
    summaries.1.label is "1:Aria"
    (batch_scores (range 1 3)) is list 10, 20, 30
    (run_relay (list 3, 0, 4)) is list 6
    (parse_line "urgent [42] down") is "urgent:42:down"
    parsed_summary.id is 9
    rolled is 1
    ("abc" as number or 0) is 0
    "abc" as number is error
end
```

## 3. Grammar, Precedence & Built-ins

- **Contracts & narrowing**: `to fn p as <type>` (`number`, `text`, `<Def>`, `<mod>.<Def>`, `list of <type>`). `def U = A | B` (2+ unique variants; union records differ in mandatory field/type/disjoint union). `check x is Variant` narrows `x`; `<val> is <type>` checks membership (no type on left of `is`). `any xs where cond` / `none xs where cond` are short-circuit conditions only (never storable).
- **Casts & `match`**: Two-step JSON cast: `m = raw as json` then `m as User`. `<expr> as <type> or <fallback>` works on `number`, `text`, scalar unions (without `or`, invalid casts yield `error`). `match <txt_or_list> ... end` supports `{...}`, `{name}`, `{name: N}`, `{name as number|Union}`, `'raw'`; text expression `match` requires `else`.
- **Concurrency & Precedence**: `swarm loop xs ... end` runs parallel workers (outer read-only; yield via `-> val`; `-> stop` halts `loop`/`take`; `-> return` exits void `to`). `inbox` cap 64; `put`/`close` are void. Precedence (high->low): `1: () . : with` | `2: prefix fn (a + b) c` | `3: where, as, -x` | `4: * / %` | `5: + -` (strict `num+num`, `txt+txt`, numeric list; mix via `"{a}{b}"`) | `6: < <= > >= is is not` | `7: not, and, or`. `"..."` escapes: `\n \r \t \" \\ \{ \}`; `'...'` is raw.
- **Built-ins**: `say val` (void), `ask prompt`, `type val`, `fields rec_or_map`, `abs n`, `floor n`, `round n`, `min a b`, `max a b`, `count`, `range low high` (int list `low..high`, NOT random!), `append`, `slice`, `split`, `join`, `trim`, `upper`, `lower`, `replace`, `contains` (cond), `sum`, `avg`, `sort [by k1, -k2]` (stable asc, `-it.x` desc, union declaration order), vector `+ - * / %`, `load`/`save path [as text | json | csv | bytes]`.
- **Modules (`import mod; mod:verb; mod.type`)**:
  - `random`: `random:roll low high`, `random:pick non_empty_list`, `random:shuffle list`.
  - `screen`: `screen.screen` (`width`, `height`, `title`, `fps`), `screen.box`, `screen.circle`, `screen.line`, `screen.triangle`, `screen.label`, `screen.scene`, `screen.event`, `screen.frame_state`; `screen:clear`, `screen:draw`, `screen:show`, `screen:open`, `screen:present`.
  - `network`: `network.network`, `network:fetch`, `network:send`, `network:serve_http`, `network:reply_text`, `network:reply_json`, `network:serve_tcp`, `network:tcp_send`.
  - `synth`: `synth.melody` (`notes`, `bpm`, `wave`, `volume`, `repeat`), `synth:play`, `synth:stop`.
  - `system`: `system.arguments`, `system.ok`, `system:exit`, `system.command`, `system:run` -> `system.process_report`.

## 4. Execution & Trace Quick-Check

- **`where` re-indexes to `1..M` in two steps**: Step 1: `xs where cond` creates a brand-new list `[v1, v2, ...]` of length `M` (original indices are discarded!). Step 2: `loop (xs where cond) -> expr` assigns `it.index = 1` to `v1`, `it.index = 2` to `v2`, ..., `it.index = M` to `vM` (`.index` exists ONLY directly on `it`). Example: `xs = list 10, 30, 50, 5` -> `xs where it > 10` is `list 30, 50`; `loop (xs where it > 10) -> it * 10 + it.index` produces `list (30*10+1), (50*10+2)` = `list 301, 502` (sum = `803`), NOT original indices `2, 3`!
- **Short-circuit `any` / `none` (and static ban on storing)**: `any xs where cond` stops IMMEDIATELY as soon as the first element satisfies `cond` — remaining elements are NEVER evaluated (so a later element that would divide by zero never executes and NO `runtime_error` occurs!). Likewise `none` stops on the first matching element. Storing `x = any ...` or `x = none ...` in a variable is a static `type_error`.
- **Closed literal unions sort in declaration order**: `sort xs by it.prio` for `def Prio = "critical" | "high" | "low"` puts `"critical"` before `"high"` before `"low"` — NEVER alphabetical!
- **Record vs List `with`**: Record fields have NO dot (`r with retries = r.retries + 1`); 1-based list elements require a dot (`xs with .2 = 99`, `xs with .(idx) = v`). `/` always divides as float; wrap computed indices (`xs.((floor (s / 60)) + 1)`).
- **Static errors vs runtime errors**: Assigning a condition (`any`/`none`), mutating a param/global wrongly, or type mismatching is a `type_error`; invalid unguarded casts like `"abc" as number` or `n / 0` evaluated at runtime fail with `runtime_error` / `error`.
